title: What Remains
description: The residence is quiet in the way houses are quiet when the argument has ended. Jonas, Liora, and Tomas are all here. The question is what 'here' means now.

title: Budget Allocation — Family First
description: The family reckoning may change your priorities. Adjust the budget to reflect what you've decided matters most — the country, the family, or the impossible attempt to serve both.

title: Family — Stand Together
description: You chose them. Now prove it. Breakfast is at seven. Jonas is making the coffee. The children are actually at the table. This is what winning looks like — but it takes more work than any crisis you've managed.

title: Family — The Distance
description: They're still here. Technically. Jonas sleeps in the guest room. Liora communicates through notes. Tomas looks at you like you're a stranger who happens to live in the same house. The question is whether this is fixable.

title: Family — The Fracture
description: Jonas has stopped waiting. Liora has stopped hoping. Tomas has stopped trying. The family that survived the Halvek era is not surviving your Chancellorship. The question is whether you accept that.

title: Diplomatic Endgame — International Mediation
description: The International Forum has offered formal mediation. Both Arcturia and Orythia support the framework — which means neither trusts the other to do it alone. The question is whether mediation means peace or managed surrender.
